Two Days in Porto (sample guide for manual testing)

Note: written to exercise claim extraction and place resolution. The statements
below have not been fact-checked and may be out of date.

Start at the Lello Bookshop near the university. Entry requires a ticket bought
online in advance, and the bookshop opens at 9am every day.

Climb the Torre dos Clérigos for the best view of the old town. The tower is open
daily from 9am to 7pm.

For a break, the Majestic Café on Rua de Santa Catarina accepts reservations for
groups only. It is closed on Sundays.

We queued for twenty minutes at the bookshop on a Saturday morning.
